mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.FYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fymd , TO_CHAR(t1.TYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.TT AS tt , gr.SEBU_CD_NM AS sebu_cd_nm , gr.SEBU_CD_NM AS tt_nm , t1.INST_DAYS AS inst_days , TO_CHAR(t1.MANGI, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mangi , t1.DT AS dt , t1.PUT_Z AS z , t1.PUT_Z AS put_z FROM USPM_PORT t1 , SZM0IA ia , (SELECT sebu_cd, sebu_cd_nm FROM SZX0GR WHERE gr_cd = 'TT' AND sebu_cd != '.') gr WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TYMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.MANGI >= TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND gr.sebu_cd(+) = t1.TT ORDER BY t1.TYMD DESC, t1.FUND_CD ASC, t1.PORT_NUM ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , ya.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , ya.JM_NM AS jm_nm , ya.BLBG_TCKR AS srs_cd , t1.COL AS col , t1.JONGA AS jonga , t1.PUT_PRICE AS put_price , t1.TT_VOLATILITY AS tt_volatility , t1.G30_VOLATILITY AS g30_volatility , t1.D30_VOLATILITY AS d30_volatility , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.put_price, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN t1.USD_TUJA > (NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) + NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) THEN TRUNC((t1.USD_TUJA - NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) - NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) / NULLIF(t1.put_price * 100, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END END AS max_jusu , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.put_price, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN t1.USD_TUJA > (NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) + NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) THEN TRUNC((t1.USD_TUJA - NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) - NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) / NULLIF(t2.INST_DAYS * t1.put_price * 100, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END END AS min_jusu , pp.STOCK_JUSU AS stock_jusu , pp.STOCK_CHUI AS stock_chui , pp.OPT_QTY AS opt_qty , TO_CHAR(t2.FYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fymd , F_OPT_COLOR(t1.CORP_GR, t1.YMD, t1.FUND_CD, t1.JM_CD, t1.JONGA) AS line_color FROM USPM t1 , USPM_PORT t2 , (SELECT opt.PORT , opt.JM_CD , opt.STOCK_JUSU , opt.STOCK_CHUI , opt.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT , opt.OPT_QTY FROM USPM_OPT opt WHERE opt.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND opt.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND opt.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) pp , SYM0YA ya WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.PORT_NUM = #{portNum} AND t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND t2.TYMD = t1.YMD AND t2.PORT_NUM = t1.PORT_NUM AND pp.port(+) = '(' || t1.PORT_NUM || ')' AND pp.jm_cd(+) = t1.JM_CD AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM, t1.COL, t1.JM_CD

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.PORT_NUM AS port_num , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , jj.JJ_NM AS xx_yj_cd , jj.JJ_NM AS jm_nm , '' AS srs_cd , t1.COL AS col , t1.JONGA AS jonga , t1.PUT_PRICE AS put_price , t1.TT_VOLATILITY AS tt_volatility , t1.G30_VOLATILITY AS g30_volatility , t1.D30_VOLATILITY AS d30_volatility , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.put_price, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN t1.USD_TUJA > (NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) + NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) THEN TRUNC((t1.USD_TUJA - NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) - NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) / NULLIF(t1.put_price * 100, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END END AS max_jusu , CASE WHEN NVL(t1.put_price, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN t1.USD_TUJA > (NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) + NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) THEN TRUNC((t1.USD_TUJA - NVL(pp.STOCK_CHUI, 0) - NVL(pp.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT, 0)) / NULLIF(t2.INST_DAYS * t1.put_price * 100, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END END AS min_jusu , pp.STOCK_JUSU AS stock_jusu , pp.STOCK_CHUI AS stock_chui , pp.OPT_QTY AS opt_qty , TO_CHAR(t2.FYMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fymd , F_OPT_COLOR(t1.CORP_GR, t1.YMD, t1.FUND_CD, t1.JM_CD, t1.JONGA) AS line_color FROM USPM t1 , USPM_PORT t2 , (SELECT opt.PORT , opt.JM_CD , opt.STOCK_JUSU , opt.STOCK_CHUI , opt.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT , opt.OPT_QTY FROM USPM_OPT opt WHERE opt.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND opt.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND opt.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) pp , SJM0JJ jj WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.PORT_NUM = #{portNum} AND t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND t2.TYMD = t1.YMD AND t2.PORT_NUM = t1.PORT_NUM AND pp.port(+) = '(' || t1.PORT_NUM || ')' AND pp.jm_cd(+) = t1.JM_CD AND jj.KOSCOM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND jj.DANC_GB IN ('A', 'C') ORDER BY t1.PORT_NUM, t1.COL, t1.JM_CD

SELECT t1.REC AS rec , t1.VOLATILITY AS volatility , TO_CHAR(t1.GUGAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gugan_dt , t1.BIGO AS bigo , t1.DAY_VOLATILITY AS day_volatility , t1.POS AS pos FROM TABLE(F_VOLATILITY(#{corpGr}, #{jmCd}, TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{type})) t1

SELECT t1.BETA AS beta , t1.BETA20 AS beta20 , t1.BETA60 AS beta60 , t1.BETA120 AS beta120 FROM TABLE(F_BETA(#{corpGr}, #{jisuJm}, #{jmCd}, TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) t1

SELECT t1.BETA AS beta , t1.BETA20 AS beta20 , t1.BETA60 AS beta60 , t1.BETA120 AS beta120 FROM TABLE(F_BETA_K(#{corpGr}, #{jisuJm}, #{jmCd}, TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) t1

SELECT t1.UP_DOWN AS up_down , t1.C5 AS c5 , t1.C8 AS c8 , t1.C13 AS c13 , t1.C21 AS c21 , t1.C34 AS c34 , t1.C55 AS c55 FROM TABLE(F_UP_DOWN(#{corpGr}, #{jmCd}, TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) t1

SELECT t1.UP_DOWN AS up_down , t1.C5 AS c5 , t1.C8 AS c8 , t1.C13 AS c13 , t1.C21 AS c21 , t1.C34 AS c34 , t1.C55 AS c55 FROM TABLE(F_UP_DOWN_K(#{corpGr}, #{jmCd}, TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) t1

SELECT t1.S AS s , t1.K AS k , t1.T AS t , t1.r AS r , t1.sigma AS sigma , t1.year_sigma AS year_sigma , t1.CALL_DELTA AS call_delta , t1.PUT_DELTA AS put_delta , t1.GAMMA AS gamma , t1.VEGA AS vega , t1.CALL_THETA AS call_theta , t1.PUT_THETA AS put_theta , t1.CALL_RHO AS call_rho , t1.PUT_RHO AS put_rho , ' ' AS put_jm_cd , 0 AS market_price , 0 AS imp_volatility FROM TABLE(F_DGTVR(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{fundCd}, #{portNum}, #{jmCd})) t1

SELECT t1.jm_cd FROM ( SELECT ya.jm_cd , ABS(ya.hangsa_ga - #{hangsaGa}) AS diff FROM SYM0YA ya WHERE ya.jm_cd LIKE ( SELECT CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{mangi}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'w') = '3' THEN '' ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{mangi}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'w') END || #{srsCd} || ym.SRS_MM || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{mangi}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'yy') || ' P%' FROM SZX0YM ym WHERE ym.YMD_GB = 'M' AND ym.YMD_ID = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{mangi}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'mm') ) ORDER BY diff ASC ) t1 WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT t1.CALL_DELTA AS call_delta , t1.PUT_DELTA AS put_delta , t1.GAMMA AS gamma , t1.VEGA AS vega , t1.CALL_THETA AS call_theta , t1.PUT_THETA AS put_theta , t1.CALL_RHO AS call_rho , t1.PUT_RHO AS put_rho FROM TABLE(F_DGTVR_COM(#{s}, #{t}, #{k}, #{r}, #{sigma})) t1
